training_wall_clock_s._caution: B1 and B2 keep these in different places and under different names, and each geometry has a decoy. B1's live under results/{case}/, B2's under B2_accuracy_search*/lossnorm/. The stale results/B2_* logs (2237-3257 s) belong to the OLD pre-loss-fix B2 runs whose checkpoints are not the ones used; using them would understate B2's training cost roughly tenfold. That the six values span 2,785-34,164 s and the report independently records '2,784-34,164' is the check that the right files were picked.
